## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive — SPY (1W: -2.56% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND while TLT (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +2.75%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: -8.93%) in RECOVERY confirm mixed signals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit neutral: HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +0.47%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +1.07%) CORRECTION show no clear easing or stress. Fear/policy skew mixed: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +5.81% | 1M: -8.93%) and SPY/TLT neutral point to indecision.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral — equities weaker vs bonds as SPY BELOW TREND and TLT ABOVE TREND, while yield/dollar proxies show no decisive move (ratios flagged NEUTRAL).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Narrow leadership: XBI (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +10.84%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +4.52%) ABOVE TREND showing strength, while XLK (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +3.25%) in CORRECTION — style: mixed, value/financials leading versus tech.

**5. US vs Global?**
Domestic small-caps firm: IWM (1W: +0.23% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND; EM/China soft with EEM (1W: -3.70% | 1M: +2.26%) in CORRECTION and FXI (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Selective speculation: IWM and XBI ABOVE TREND, while IBIT (1W: -6.44% | 1M: -19.75%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -3.70% | 1M: +0.08%) CORRECTION indicate risk appetite uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Metals under pressure: GLD (1W: -4.85% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -19.76%) BELOW TREND; base metals weak as CPER (1W: -5.88% | 1M: -3.27%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy broadly weak: XLE (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -7.23%) BELOW TREND while UNG (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +1.50%) ABOVE TREND — divergence inside energy complex.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Financials (XLF ABOVE TREND) and Biotech (XBI ABOVE TREND) on both recent frames; MINOR divergence overall — several industry/tech ETFs (SOXX, MTUM, XLK) in CORRECTION despite positive 1M readings across parts of the market.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to XLF and XBI showing strength and reduce exposure to XLK and China ETFs (FXI) which show weakness; monitor bonds (TLT ABOVE TREND) as a defensive hedge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +10.84%) ABOVE TREND if momentum continues; XLF (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +4.52%) ABOVE TREND for cyclicals.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +3.25%) CORRECTION and FXI (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +1.50%) ABOVE TREND if weather/demand holds.  
BEARISH: GLD (1W: -4.85% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND and broader oil ETFs (USO/BNO) BELOW TREND on weak 1M performance.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (fear threshold), HYG/LQD back above ~1.0 (credit relief signal), XLK/XLF relative spread pivot (watch XLK downside vs XLF strength).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive — SPY (1W: -2.56% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND versus TLT (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +2.75%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: -8.93%) in RECOVERY underscore mixed confirmations. XBI (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +10.84%) and XLF (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +4.52%) showing relative strength while XLK (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +3.25%) showing weakness — monitor narrow breadth and correction divergences in tech/industry ETFs.
